name: Subway
src: Subway UK & ROI Nutrition Information, November 2026 (checked 2026-11-22), per serving as listed. Subs, wraps and toasties are bread, protein, onions, cucumbers and lettuce, with no cheese or sauce unless named; footlongs are double the 6-inch, as Subway says. Footlong pizzas are the whole pizza. Ingredients (breads, proteins, cheese, sauces) are add-ons. Left out 2: Loaded Waffle Fries (Fajita) (same figures as Mac & Cheese (Fajita), a copy slip); Peppered Cheese (ROI) (Ireland only). kJ left blank where Subway's kJ doesn't match its kcal (the kcal matches the macros): Mac & Cheese (Classic), Mac & Cheese (American Hot), Mac & Cheese (Steak), Mac & Cheese (Fajita). Subway lists allergens per ingredient, not per sub, so none are given here.
